# Drift

> Drift is an iPhone app blocker that locks distracting apps until you finish tasks you choose. You earn your screen time back by doing something first: a walk, reading, chores, a workout. It uses Apple's Screen Time shield, so blocked apps stay locked at the system level. Available now on the App Store for iPhone; Android is coming soon.

Drift is made for anyone who keeps opening the same apps without meaning to: students, professionals, parents, and people trying to cut down on doomscrolling. A research team at Johns Hopkins uses Drift as the official tool in their study.

## How it works

1. **Block**: pick the apps you lose time to. Drift applies Apple's Screen Time shield to them.
2. **Earn**: complete tasks you define (walk, read, tidy, stretch, call someone back) and you decide how many minutes each one earns. Tasks can be weighted, so a deep-clean session can earn more than a short walk.
3. **Spend**: open a blocked app and your earned balance counts down only while it's open. When the balance runs out, the shield comes back.

## Key features

- System-level blocking through Apple Screen Time, not an overlay that can be dismissed
- Earned-time balance that drains only while a blocked app is open
- Weighted tasks and recurring tasks (chores, workouts, reading, bedtime resets)
- Locked windows that stay blocked even with saved minutes (bedtime, school, deep work)
- Task verification: mark tasks complete or submit quick proof; AI-reviewed proof can be appealed and appeals are reviewed manually
- Family plan: a parent assigns tasks to their kids' devices and approves them before screen time unlocks

## How Drift differs from Apple Screen Time limits

Apple's built-in limits are easy to tap past ("Ignore Limit"). Drift uses the same system-level shield, but blocked apps unlock only after a task is completed, so screen time is earned instead of ignored.

## Pricing

- Personal: $4.99/month or $29.99/year
- Family: $7.99/month for one child, up to $19.99/month for five or more children
- There is no free tier.
